in_sanskrit.name: Pranit
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Breath
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pranit एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Pranit is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prana' meaning breath or life force. The name Pranit signifies the one who is the lord of breath and represents the person who is in control of his life force and vitality.
